title: JUNIOR DESIGN I
description: Introduction to system design and group projects. Design and fabrication of an electrical engineering project in a small group.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (CS 261* or 261H*) and ENGR 203.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of C is required in CS 261, CS 261H and ENGR 203.
meeting_html: M 2pm-3:50pm in DEAR 203 - Dearborn Hall 203 (9/23 to 12/4)
